item.title: English, Writing and Journalism Short Courses
item.description: ​​​​Explore a range of online or on campus English, Writing and Journalism Short Courses, tailored to foster creativity and innovation.

item.title: Writing Comedy Genres
item.description: This online short course is a fast, practical deep‑dive into writing comedy for the screen across eight of the most powerful subgenres: horror, romantic, action‑crime, satirical‑political, sci‑fi/fantasy, workplace and family, historical, and musical comedy.

item.title: Screenwriting Fundamentals
item.description: Write a complete short screenplay over this eight-week online short course, learning the core principles that underpin effective screen storytelling. Each week you’ll explore a different element of the craft, from building compelling characters and shaping a clear narrative arc to writing efficient scenes that move the story forward.

item.title: Acting graduates perform among national names at Falmouth’s International Arts Fest
item.description: New writing talent from Cornwall was placed front and centre at this year’s Falmouth International Arts Fest (FIA Fest). item.title: Falmouth commissioned to re-create a soundscape for ATTUNE research project’s final presentation
item.description: Falmouth University has collaborated with the University of Oxford to create ATTUNE, a significant arts and mental health research project as part of the UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) £35m Adolescence Mental Health and the Developing Mind programme.

item.title: Tremough Follies: Cry-Baby The Musical
item.description: If you’re looking for a show that blends the romance of West Side Story with the energy and fun of Grease, then Cry-Baby is the one to see!

item.title: Children's Book Design in InDesign July 2026
item.description: Join this one-day course for aspiring book illustrators or authors and learn to lay out your book professionally in Adobe InDesign. We’ll teach you all the technical basics that you need as well as look at creative ways that you can use type to appeal to a young audience. When 15th July 2026 from 9.30am - 4.30pm Where This course is taught in our digital print facilities on our Falmouth campus.

item.title: Creative Writing course leaders collaborate to release new book with Bloomsbury Academic
item.description: Two of Falmouth’s course leaders have collaborated to release a collection of essays that interrogate the creative writing workshop model and offer practical suggestions on what is a contemporary approach to creative writing. item.title: Online Fine Art student wins International Amateur Photographer of the Year
item.description: Between travelling the world and exploring diverse cultures and natural wonders, working as a creative director for a jewellery retailer and studying on Falmouth’s MA Fine Art (Online) course, Bircan Harper also found the time to take part in a yearlong photography competition, where she has now won the top prize and been named International Amateur Photographer of the Year 2025.
